name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: Pops automatically the instant the other 54 trophies are yours. The GTA VI list has no online, co-op or DLC trophies, so one clean PS5 save is all you need. Budget roughly 200 hours: 60-80 for the story, another ~100 for the 100% Completion Checklist, and a final ~10 for Strangers & Freaks and misc cleanup. Nothing toward the platinum is permanently missable except one Chapter 1 meditation, so lock that down early and everything else can be finished in free-roam after the credits. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so never enable one on your main save; keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Unmissable, story-related. Pops at the end of the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, where you play as Jason out on the water. There is nothing extra to do - the list has no mission gold medals, so just finish the mission. If it doesn't appear the moment the mission ends, let the following cutscene play out fully; some early trophies land a beat after the next mission opens rather than on the exact end screen.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Paradise Lost
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks once you clear the final mission of Chapter 1 and start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?. Don't rush the chapter break: this is your only window for the Chapter 1 balcony meditation that Positive Mental Attitude can require, so grab it before leaving Jason's house. Keep a manual save at the end of Chapter 1 so you can reload if you realise you skipped it.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: T**s Ass Drug Money
guide: Unmissable. Pops at the start of Chapter 3, after the Welcome to Vice City mission, not at the literal end of Chapter 2, so don't panic if it hasn't appeared when the chapter wraps up. The name is masked with asterisks in the official list. Keep playing the main pink-icon missions; there is no hidden objective or side condition to chase for this one.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. The trigger is chapter completion, not any optional objective, so play normally and don't go hunting for hidden conditions. Chapter 4 is the longest chapter in the game, so once this lands you're past the halfway point of the campaign and can expect the remaining story missions to come in a steady run.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Top Of The World, Ma
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. This is the point of no return for the main plot, so before you launch it, make sure your Chapter 1 meditation is done and you have a save you're happy with. Everything else trophy-relevant stays available in free-roam afterwards, so it's not a soft-lock, just a checkpoint.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks after the very last story mission, Starting From Zero. You are returned to free-roam afterwards, so this closes the campaign rather than ending your file. Once it pops, the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion - that checklist is where most of the remaining hours toward A Long Road will go.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Trust
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks during Chapter 2's main mission Breakfast Run, where you check on Jason. No special conditions - just complete the mission. Keep a save before it if you want to experiment with partner switching, since free-roaming as both Jason and Lucia together only opens up after Chapter 2's Coffee Break mission.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Break the Bank
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks during Chapter 3's main mission The Cartel Heist, a long set-piece job. Top up on body armour and full ammo at an Ammu-Nation before starting, and lean on the autosave checkpoints. There is no gold-medal objective to worry about - surviving to the end of the mission is all that matters.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Family Matters
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks during Chapter 4's main mission Child's Play, where you rescue Rafa from kidnappers. It's a combat-heavy mission, so an assault rifle and body armour make the firefights far less punishing. Finish the mission and the trophy pops alongside it; no stealth or optional goal gates it.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: DWNFALL
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks during Chapter 4's main mission Headliners, where you help with the launch party. The name is stylised in all caps and isn't a typo. It's mostly escort and crowd-control work rather than heavy combat, so follow the objectives and don't over-prepare with explosives that could catch civilians and fail the mission. The trophy lands the moment the mission completes.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks during Chapter 4's main mission VCIA Takedown, where you hit Vice City airport. Expect a chase and a shootout across the runways, so keep a fast, armoured car and full ammo ready before you trigger the mission. No stealth run or optional objective is required - blast through to the end and the trophy follows as soon as the mission completes.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Snow Storm
guide: Unmissable. Unlocks during Chapter 5's main mission Operation Savage Glory, one of the final combat set-pieces of the game. Top up on ammo, body armour and health items before you start, and expect a sustained firefight. Finishing it also sets up the endgame, but the trophy itself needs nothing beyond surviving to mission completion - there are no graded objectives to chase.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: A Long Road
guide: The real platinum gate. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist. It's closer to 60% true completion: most side quests and collectible types aren't required at all. The only categories that need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's quests. You need any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, and any 70 of 80 Challenges - so skip the ten hardest challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across four categories: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. The trophy only counts the total completed, so mix freely and lean on Under the Bridges, which are the quickest to clear. Track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots - each one stays marked once done. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this pops on the way there.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All 130 Stunt Jump Locations
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Do each of the nine activity types at least once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, a Video Game, a Race (street, Race Challenge or Top Fun drone race), and a Stunt. The story walks you into most of them, and you can check your per-type count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You'll tick all nine naturally while chasing the other trophies, so don't grind this one on its own.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Unlike the story, these ranges do have graded medals, and accuracy plus speed decide the grade. Use an accurate weapon, learn each course's target order, and retry the tight ones until you can string a clean run. Ranges are marked with their own icon on the map and all stay available in free-roam after the story, so nothing here is missable.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations, which together host 42 drone races. Locations appear as you unfog the map, and every one stays available in free-roam. Winning just once per location is enough - you don't need gold times, only a first-place finish. This is one of the few categories the 100% checklist wants completed, so clear all 14 locations in a single pass.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Top Fun Drone Race Locations

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 distinct race events. The counter tracks different races, not repeat wins, so travel to new race icons and take first place at each. Street races, Race Challenges and Top Fun drone races all count. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many you have left. There are far more than 20 races in Leonida, so you never need to 100% the map for this one.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After Chapter 1's Feng Shui mission (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a purple fishing icon; follow his questline until he challenges you directly, then out-fish him. Cast into deeper water, watch the rod tip, and set the hook on the first solid pull. Cal's line stays available through free-roam, so you can do it any time after it unlocks.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Finish all the levels of any one arcade game. Four exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are all playable at the TV in your home from Chapter 1 onward, and Bang For Your Buck sits in arcade machines around the map. You only need to reach the end of a single game's levels once - not every challenge within it. Tenebrae Lux is the shortest, so use it for a fast clear.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap

name: Road to Rehabilitation
description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It gets marked in Chapter 3 when Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All of them remain available after the story, so nothing about this questline is missable.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap

name: This Was No Boat Accident
description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It's marked after Chapter 1's Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), when he calls and gets a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He tasks you with clearing 7 shipwrecks for treasure - use the metal detector on the ocean floor to dig up each one. Kenton temporarily disappears after Chapter 1 but returns during Chapter 2-3 (calling Brian as Jason speeds it up), so he's never permanently gone.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap

description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All of them remain available after the story, so take the questline at your own pace.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only true 'stranger' strands count - optional questlines like Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Moses and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters include Kirk's Skunk Ape line, Kyle's farm line, Yago's street-race line and Pilot Pete's delivery line. Track the running count via the trophy tracker in the trophy list. Every strand stays available in free-roam, so nothing is missable.

GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in Grand Theft Auto VI

description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, marked after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. He hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to deliver. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they're on the list, then drive them to his green 'RK' garage in west Vice City. You can steal the cars anywhere - Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds. The whole list remains available after the story.

Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Spin On This!
description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is exclusive to Jason. Marked after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, it sends you to destroy Synthetic Labs shown with purple icons. Clear enough labs to trigger his second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it unlocks the trophy. All of it remains available in free-roam after the story.

Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating as both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts +2, so you don't strictly need every physical location. The risk is the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house: after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept. That one isn't marked like the others and disappears after Chapter 1, so grab it early. The last spots only open once you can play both characters after Coffee Break.
missableNote: The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house balcony (after Down to Earth) becomes permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends - follow Lucia to the balcony and choose Accept before the chapter closes.

Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is exclusive to Jason and gets marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when he texts about his first quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia never receives the message). Do that first quest to receive the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, then work his hunting requests until the unique animal triggers the trophy. The 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities are required for 100% anyway.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Card packs are earned and found around the map; check Progress > Collections to see which sets you're closest to finishing. There are far more than three sets, so just finish whichever come together first as you explore. Nothing here is missable - every set can be completed in free-roam after the story.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: You WAiNKer!
guide: WAiNK-scan at 100 locations by holding up on the d-pad and R1 at scanable objects. There are far more than 100: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher Tags all count. Any 100 will do, so scan everything you pass. This chains nicely with Whip It Good and The Goodtime State - scan vehicles, objects and unfog the map in the same loop.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this pops automatically on the way to A Long Road - don't grind it separately. View and track them under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while you do other trophies. Leave it for near the end, then mop up whichever easy ones remain.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Challenges Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner after Chapter 2's Coffee Break unlocks free-roam together. Call your partner (hold right + triangle), cause carnage to reach 4 stars, then escape. The easiest out is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County - cops can't follow on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone, not the blue/red search circle.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level, unlockable after Coffee Break. Hit three green robbery targets while the police chase stays active - wear armour, bring sticky bombs, and keep moving between stores. The three jewellery stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) make a tight, reliable route. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it's slow.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold up, then R1). There are 557 vehicles at launch, so 100 comes fast. Stand at a busy road and scan everything that passes; you don't need to drive or own any of them. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model scans, so this pops naturally while you work that - and remember to scan boats and aircraft too when you're near water or airstrips.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming), which slows time and marks weak spots. Buff focus first with food, a shower, or Adrenaline to extend it, then line up five gang members at an Illegal Operation. Use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 and get close with body armour. It won't count soldiers, police or civilians. Leveling Focus through shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing makes it much easier.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Steal a passenger plane docked to a boarding bridge at VCIA airport - planes parked on the open airfield don't count. Head for departure terminals E3/E4, enter via the stairs beside the boarding bridge, get upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the strip, take off and fly about 1km away. The unlock is delayed until you're far enough out. Don't waste time with the loose planes on the tarmac.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Challenging Tank
guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks sit at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump at the south-east entrance, climb into a tank, and shoot enemies from inside until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance the moment you grab it.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewellery store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Use the back door with the Snap Gun - not the kick prompt, which trips the alarm - then find the safe-code note inside and open the safe undetected. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a clean spot for this.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is..., where you follow a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always earn 4 stars - escape on a fast bike, then swap vehicles. The 100% checklist needs all 8, each paying up to $205,000, and Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) also counts, as long as you then clear the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. To do it early, box an armoured truck in with a heavy vehicle, plant a sticky bomb on the rear doors, blow them open and get away clean. Either path works - the escape is the part that actually registers.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: The Goodtime State
guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. The fastest method is a fast plane, flying low over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed. Pair it with You WAiNKer! and Whip It Good by scanning landmarks and vehicles as you cover each region. Nothing about it is missable - you can finish the whole map in free-roam after the story.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) Trophy List

name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Gang operations are marked around the map as you unfog it, and each belongs to a specific gang. Clear one op per gang, not every op on the map. These double as good Gunslinger practice since they're full of clustered enemies for Combat Focus, so do the two together. All of them remain available after the story.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar along the Ocean Beach strip, order a cocktail and drink it with the ocean in view. The exact unlock conditions are still thinly documented, so if it doesn't pop on the first drink, try different bars along the strip and make sure you actually finish the drink rather than walking away mid-sip. It's a relaxed secret trophy with no missable window.

guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Find a car showroom - several sit around Vice City - and drive a display vehicle straight out through the front window or door to trigger the escape. No specific vehicle is required. It's a 'break the glass' style easter-egg trophy; if one showroom doesn't register, try another with a faster car and make sure you exit the lot cleanly rather than dying to the shop's security.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap

guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. It plays out at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn as a small robbery with a follow-through: steal the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the contents of the safe in the north-east hallway office - bring sticky bombs for the safe, then escape the police. Valuables you grabbed on an earlier run still count if you return later.

name: Personal Best
guide: A partnership with mass appeal - reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. Visit fitness clubs and train together so the inactive partner works out alongside the character you control, which levels both at once. It's a slow stat grind, so start visiting gyms early and return between missions. Nothing about it is missable.

GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: Choices made (for better or worse) - rack up 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Robberies, enemy encounters and open-world crime all contribute naturally, so leave this until your other jobs are done and most of it will already be banked. Watch the counter under your Criminal Profile in Progress. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile only if you want cops less aggressive; it doesn't block the trophy.

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock isn't fully documented yet, but the wording points to failing or botching something and then succeeding on a retry - most likely a heist, robbery or a mission that lets you try again. Keep a manual save before big jobs, and if you fail one, reload and complete it on the second attempt rather than restarting a whole playthrough.

It reportedly triggers at night from Chapter 2 near the Starlet Motel east of Port Gellhorn: follow an abandoned car by a woodland trail to a misty clearing where a UFO is beaming someone up, then return to the car and the UFO appears overhead to unlock the trophy. Go at night with a save beforehand, since the trigger window is specific.

guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The unlock steps aren't confirmed yet, but the description describes knocking someone over from a moving vehicle with a melee attack - likely a bike drive-by where you swing a melee weapon or throw a punch at a pedestrian and send them flying. Try it on a bicycle or motorcycle at low speed against a lone pedestrian, and expect the game to judge the knockdown.

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; your fence contacts turn them into clean money over time. Keep feeding marked cash to every contact you unlock rather than hoarding it, and combine with Maximum Withdrawal - each bank vault pays up to $205,000, so the haul adds up fast. Check Progress > Characters for your fence network.

name: Treat Yo Self
guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. There's no single-shop requirement, just cumulative spending, so spread purchases across clothes, gun stores, convenience stores, food and properties. It comes naturally while you buy the weapons, armour and vehicles the other trophies ask for. Check the cumulative total under Progress > Stats.

name: Little Boxes
guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are marked on the map as you explore; buy each one as the money comes in from robberies and heists. Some are pricey, so prioritise them after you've banked the bank-vault money from Maximum Withdrawal. Nothing is missable - every garage can be bought in free-roam.

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app from your phone, pick any owned or parked vehicle, and register it - you don't need to buy ten cars, just register ten distinct vehicles you've acquired. Scan for new models with WAiNK while you're at it. This is a quick one to mop up alongside Whip It Good.
